rationale: The 08:07 UTC nightly (run 40511561300) spent ~6600s of its 7035s wall queued for macOS/Windows runners inside the org's nightly cluster. The off-peak slot lands before that cluster and before EU business hours; the existing run stays as the full-matrix backstop, so the added cron is purely additive. Required check names are unchanged: the off-peak run emits only the OS legs the day's diff can affect, and every emitted label is one of the exact matrix.os values ci.yml already uses, so `Test (${{ matrix.os }})` check names match today's names verbatim.
